description: Preview edits to existing Meta campaigns, ad sets and ads without changing Meta: status, archive, delete, name, budget, bid (including minimum ROAS), schedule, spend limit, targeting, ad set settings and set_creative (ad text, links and call to action). At most 10 creative edits per plan. Targeting is patched; ads_search_targeting finds IDs and detail: full returns the full resulting audience. set_creative covers standard, placement-customised, multi-media and carousel creatives, with per-card headline, description and link through cards[{card, headline, description, link}]; per-card links are refused on placement-customised carousels. Flexible, catalog, partnership, language and segment customisations are refused with a reason. To change an image or video, create a new ad in the Uploader. Returns the planned changes, warnings (for example ENGAGEMENT_RESET when likes, comments and shares stay with the old post, or NO_CHANGE when a value already matches Meta), requiredConfirmations and settings: the account's edit mode and approval rule, with settings.launch as the separate permission for new-ad launches. In Apply Directly mode it returns a planId that ads_edit_apply takes for 15 minutes. In review mode it queues the changes in the Agent Inbox and returns reviewId and reviewUrl with no plan; the changes are applied when approved there, and nothingQueued: true means every change already matched. reason and runTitle label the suggestions in the Agent Inbox, and a per-operation reason overrides the top-level reason; reviewId adds them to an existing review, moving identical pending suggestions into it, and without reviewId identical pending suggestions are reused instead of queued twice. idempotencyKey makes a repeated request return the same preview (PREVIEW_IN_PROGRESS while the first is still running). Reviews stay readable for seven days after their last update; ads_list_inbox_history keeps 90 days.
